name: armasu-finding-bucket
description: Sort Armasu review findings into the four change buckets the owner allowed (bug, speed, a11y, ux) or out, which needs a look, copy or feature change

bucket.instructions: Read `what` and `evidence` for a finding on the page in `where`. Decide which kind of change fixes it. The cue is what the fix touches: wrong behaviour, bytes, readability or input, a missing state, or the design itself.

criteria.bug: The page or route does something other than what its own code or label says: wrong data shown, a stored value not read back, a control that does nothing, a crash, a label that is a raw internal value. The fix changes behaviour only where it was wrong.
criteria.speed: The page sends more bytes or requests than it needs, or does repeated work, and nothing the user sees would change once fixed: image sizes, bundle size, duplicate fetches, unbounded memory.
criteria.a11y: Text or a control cannot be read or operated by everyone: contrast, a clipped or truncated label, text under the 11px floor, focus order, a missing accessible name, a touch target too small, motion that ignores a reduced-motion setting.
criteria.ux: A state is missing or wrong while the layout stays the same: no loading, empty, error or disabled state, a notice that covers a control, a scrollable strip with no hint that it scrolls, a keyboard path that stops.
criteria.out: Fixing it would change the layout, colours, type, copy or a feature, or the finding describes behaviour that is correct by design, or it is a note rather than a defect.
